posts.title: Recharging for a month
posts.description: One of the many perks of working at Meta is Recharge: after five years of employment, you become eligible for 30 days off work! Having an entire month off sounds incredible, but I quickly realized that making the most of it required answering two surprisingly difficult questions: When is the best time to take recharge? posts.title: Visiting Japan (東京マラソンを走る)
posts.description: For years, I had wanted to visit Japan, but cycling trips in Europe always seemed more tempting and kept winning out. Then, the day before the Tokyo Marathon lottery closed, a friend convinced me to apply. I didn’t expect much, but a few months later I received the email: I was selected. posts.title: A week cycling in Girona and Catalonia
posts.description: In September 2025, I had the pleasure of visiting Girona, Spain . Girona is a popular cycling hub where numerous famous athletes including Jan Frodeno reside because of the excellent weather, roads, and variety of routes available.
